item: [L2] Egress check passes during the CLI runs (localhost only); and the check scripts of every q07 L2 item
why: The scripts need python3, the egress check needs strace and the diff check needs git; ubuntu:24.04 ships none of them. All three are grader tools and must be identical for both groups.

candidates.source: Ubuntu 24.04 (noble) archive: apt-get install -y python3 strace git
candidates.license: python3: PSF License; strace: LGPL-2.1-or-later; git: GPL-2.0
candidates.size: a few tens of MB installed
candidates.pin: Bake into the grading image before any answer runs; record `dpkg-query -W python3 strace git` and the image digest in calibration.md. If git must not be in the image the answers see, copy /work/project out after the runs and run diff_check.py on the grader's machine instead (git version recorded); pick one way for both groups.
